correctness.rationale: PASS: The regular basis dx/y, dx/y^2, x dx/y^2 has pole and branch orders compatible with genus 3. Cartier semilinearity gives omega1 -> sqrt(b)*omega2+sqrt(d)*omega3, omega2 ->0, omega3 ->omega1. Smoothness forces (b,d) not (0,0), rank 2 gives a-number1. Iterated rank is zero when d=0 and two when d≠0; in d=0 the additive separable quartic L(x)=x4+a x2+b x has V4 translation action with three elliptic genus-one quotients Y^2+(b/t)Y=X^3+c, each smooth supersingular j=0, and odd-ell character decomposition induces Jacobian isogeny to their product. d≠0 gives p-rank2 and symmetry forces the remaining slope pair 1/2. In Fq, fprime=d x^2+b: d=0 requires b!=0, d!=0 excludes exactly one c per (d,a,b), producing marked counts.
